resultMessageFormat.line2: JSON: {"t":"<tester>","at":"<ISO timestamp>","r":[{"i":"<item id>","g":"<guess text>","ms":<time to guess in ms>,"cm":"<optional pre-reveal comment>","cm2":"<optional post-reveal comment>"}, ...]}
resultMessageFormat.versioningNote: The answer-reveal step (and its 'cm2' post-reveal comment field) was added mid-round, after the link had already gone out to some testers. Anyone who opened the page before that point kept running the pre-reveal version for their whole session (it's a single-page app, so it doesn't hot-update mid-session even though the URL is unchanged). Their results will simply have no 'cm2' on any item — this is expected, not an error, and doesn't affect scoring/timing (i, g, ms, cm are present in both versions).
